payload_fixture.fixture: 240 synthetic completed full-plan outcomes, not production sizing/SLA

audit.scope: Self-consistency of server simulation records, not external authenticity, physical arrival or witnessed social effects. Legacy evidence is not backfilled.

limits: Evidence describes simulation elapsed-time/plan matching, not physical arrival, social witnessing, hearsay, commitment fulfillment or clinical facts.
Offline inspector verifies self-consistency only; a fabricated external file is not authenticated or permitted to train/import into runtime.
The original v1 raw reward is preserved. No new social/travel/commitment reward, role hierarchy or H6 replay importer is enabled.
Missing/weak legacy evidence is not reconstructed from ETA, text, current state or inferred decision context.
Working snapshot retains200 summaries; durable archive retains all outcomes and full evidence. Future archive replay still needs an explicit source/version/authority policy.
Synthetic size fixture is not a D1 cost, production payload budget, hardware performance or uptime guarantee.
Society WP20–27 and NIM pilots are conditional future backlog. No new paid API, scheduler, public audience, vector DB, family/lifecycle or hosted production dependency.
Native Sites credential/deploy/status/database tools remain unavailable; candidate preparation does not deploy or verify live production.
